FN-SBFV85-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 21
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/20/2023
House Bill 21as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of law enforcement
agencies and the Department of Forensic Sciences to annually report certain data regarding
sexual assault cases to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA).
In addition, this bill could increase the obligations of ALEA by an undetermined amount to
collect and store this data on sexual assault cases and to provide an annual summary report of
this information to the Chairs of the House and Senate Judiciary Committees.
